title: Find a listening TCP process
text: Inspect listening sockets and their processes with ss -ltnp. Permissions may affect process information.

title: Variables in a subshell
text: Changes made in a subshell do not update the parent shell environment. A pipeline may create a subshell.

title: Inspect disk usage
text: The du command reports file and directory disk usage. Symbolic-link handling depends on the selected options.

title: Directory permission bits
text: Read permission lists entries. Execute permission allows traversing the directory.

title: Exit codes in shell pipelines
text: In Bash, PIPESTATUS contains exit statuses for the most recently executed foreground pipeline.
Use journalctl to inspect system journal messages. Filter by unit when investigating a service.

title: Difference between a hard link and a symbolic link
Case-sensitive file names
text: Readme and README can name different files on a case-sensitive filesystem. Keep the original text.
